notes.title: After a long wait, Psychonauts 2 has an official Linux version now
notes.notes:
Psychonauts 2 was originally crowdfunded via Fig back in 2016, and now near a year after the Windows release the Native Linux version is now available.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/after-a-long-wait-psychonauts-2-has-an-official-linux-version-now

notes.title: Latest Update Released
notes.notes:
The latest update contains the following exciting changes:
[list]
[*] Add two additional text languages.
[*] Fix stability of the Strike City checkpoint at the end of the level.
[*] macOS and Linux versions released.
[/list]
In addition, here is more information about the new Mac and Linux versions.

[b]macOS[/b]

General information and troubleshooting:
[list]
[*] Save data location: ~/Library/Containers/com.doublefine.psychonauts2/Data/Library/Application Support/Epic/Psychonauts2/Saved
[*] Run the game on the latest macOS version if possible (12.4 as of May 2022) to ensure stability
[*] Xbox gamepads are not fully supported. Please use a PlayStation 4 or PlayStation 5 gamepad
[*] Due to the large file size, app verification that occurs the first time you launch the game may take several minutes to complete on SSDs, and upwards of 15 minutes on slower hard drive storage
[*] Changing resolution is handled by the "Resolution Scaling" slider found in the Settings > Graphics menu
[/list]
[b]Linux[/b]

Save data is located in: ~/.config/Epic/Psychonauts2/

The game may crash at launch or when attempting to alter Display settings such as Window Mode. Please try the following troubleshooting solutions:
[list]
[*] Use alternate display drivers, found in Software & Updates > Additional Drivers
[*] Go to Settings > Appearance and reposition the Activities bar to the bottom of the screen
[*] Use an alternate desktop environment (DE) such as Gnome on X.Org or Ubuntu on Wayland
[*] Try changing the resolution with the "Resolution Scaling" slider found in the Settings > Graphics menu
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1089619 Released
notes.notes:
Update 1089619 addressed the following issues:
[list]
[*] Fix intermittent hitches on PC.
[*] Fix water in Bob's Bottles displays incorrectly in photo mode.
[*] Fix lighting issues in Strike City and Cassie's Collection
[*] Fix dialog tree delay in Fatherland Follies.
[*] Fix Panic Attack not using its phantom attack during Psychoseismometer battles.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1088619 Released
notes.notes:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bonus Psychoseismometer unlocked in Otto's lab after finishing Gisu's quest, making it possible to unlock enemy achievements during post-game state.
[*]Check marks appear in location selection menus to indicate if all collectibles in a location have been found.
[*]Otto-Spot photo filter to show collectibles in the Otto-Shot photo mode.
[*]Show all available figments in the figment viewer menu even if you haven't found them yet.
[/list]

[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]General stability improvements for all platforms.
[*]Improve environmental collision to prevent player and objects rarely falling through walls and floors.
[*]Fix issues related to fall death and water curse, and preventing them from being broken if interrupted by a cutscene.
[*]Fix duplicate characters and stray animation appearing in some cutscenes.
[*]Fix issue that could cause flickering around objects submerged in water.
[*]Improve save checkpoints to prevent the player's save data getting into a bad state.
[*]Improve photo mode stability.
[*]Expand the mental health advisory message.
[*]HUD improvements to prevent extra health brains from appearing.
[*]Improve PS4 version's resolution and stability on PS5.
[*]Pause PC version when controller is unplugged.
[*]Standardize PC controls between cutscenes and dialogue trees.
[*]Improve xCloud streaming touch controls.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1087071 Released
notes.notes:
Game version is viewable in the Settings menu.

Version 1087071 addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*] The player could get stuck in Cruller's Correspondence if they quit after hitting the first lever and then resuming the game.
[*] The player could get stuck if they view the final tableau with Bob in the Mote of Light's quiet place and then quit and resume the game.
[*] The player may not be able to proceed past the Nose/Mouth Shrine due to missing instruments after the Panic Attack battle.
[*] The player could skip the moth introduction cutscene in Bob's Bottles and get blocked from progressing further.
[*] The player could get stuck if they unlocked Otto's gadgets in the post-game state and then quit without triggering a checkpoint.
[*] Poses for Otto-Shot were not available in the Windows version of the game.
[*] The Steam version of the game would fail to start on Windows 7.
[/list]

notes.title: Psychonauts 2 release date pushed to 2020
notes.notes:
If you were eagerly awaiting the next chapter in the Psychonauts series, it looks like you'll be waiting a little longer, as Psychonauts 2's release date has been moved back to 2020.

As Double Fine explains in the latest backer update, the studio's had a pretty busy year. Having been acquired by Xbox Game Studios, Microsoft has now taken over as publisher from troubled company Starbreeze, and while Psychonauts 2 will still be published on all promised platforms (including PlayStation 4), Double Fine says it still needs a bit more time.

"We know it's always disappointing when you have to wait a bit longer, but we also know that you are an amazing, supportive bunch, who - just like us - want the game to be as good as possible," the post reads. "We're hopeful you'll understand! <3"
